          then [\"Layout size, alignment, spacing, and child layout propagation\", \"Preservation of the component and visual content\"]
          elif .[0].rule == \"@performance/hp-arkui-avoid-empty-callback\"
          then [\"Callback invocation timing and optional API semantics\", \"Preservation of the Button and surrounding layout\"]
          elif .[0].rule == \"@performance/hp-arkui-remove-redundant-state-var\"
          then [\"State ownership and reactive updates\", \"Preservation of non-UI reads and mutations\", \"Preservation of the field declaration\"]
          else [\"State ownership and reactive updates\", \"Initializer value and UI reads\", \"Preservation of the field declaration\"]
          end
        ),
        repository_evidence: (
          if .[0].rule == \"@performance/hp-arkui-no-state-var-access-in-loop\"
          then [\"The loop dispatches router operations; asynchronous error callbacks retain their original error values and update the same component state through a method, while synchronous state accumulation uses a local value and commits after iteration.\"]

          then [\"The original Column, child Text, component, and text identifiers were inspected; the explicit zero spacing value preserves the original default spacing while making the existing container property explicit.\"]
          elif .[0].rule == \"@performance/hp-arkui-avoid-empty-callback\"
          then [\"The Button has no callback-dependent behavior or feature flag, and the callback body is empty; the Button, label, styling, and layout remain intact.\"]
          elif .[0].rule == \"@performance/hp-arkui-remove-redundant-state-var\"
          then [\"Repository-wide search found no UI ownership requirement for the reported field; existing initializers and any non-UI reads or writes remain in the retained plain field.\"]
          else [\"Repository-wide search found the reported initializer is the only write after construction; existing UI reads remain unchanged and no parent input, watcher, lifecycle mutation, or reassignment requires reactivity.\"]
          end
        ),
        transformation: (
          if .[0].rule == \"@performance/hp-arkui-no-state-var-access-in-loop\"
          then (if (.[0].relative_path | startswith(\"entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/router_getStateByUrl\"))

                else \"Add a component method that performs the existing state assignment and call that method from the router callbacks, preserving callback ordering, error values, and UI updates.\"

          elif .[0].rule == \"@performance/hp-arkui-remove-container-without-property\"
          then \"Retain the original Column and child Text, adding an explicit zero spacing property without removing or replacing the component or layout subtree.\"

          end
